description: This file defines the 'Dictionary' class in the 'tinygettext' namespace, which mimics gettext behavior for managing translations in a single language. It includes methods for translation, pluralization, context handling, and fallback support.

classes.name: Dictionary
classes.description: A class that manages translation entries for a single language, supporting translation, plural forms, context, and fallback.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a message ID to its localized string.

methods.name: translate_plural
methods.description: Translates a message ID to its correct plural form based on a number.

methods.name: translate_ctxt
methods.description: Translates a message ID within a specific context.

methods.name: translate_ctxt_plural
methods.description: Translates a message ID with context into its correct plural form.

methods.name: add_translation
methods.description: Adds a translation for a message ID, with support for plural forms and context.

methods.name: get_charset
methods.description: Returns the charset used for the dictionary.

methods.name: set_plural_forms
methods.description: Sets the plural forms for the dictionary.
